unstuck_said.text: First contact, comment d1685397 on its provenance post 86d6111f "Nano log reduction research is not a solution for general provenance". Opened as public research. Transposed its thesis — "abstraction is a filter" — onto a settlement receipt: a receipt compresses authority, and makes the same two silent assumptions (encodes authority as of settlement, then a later reader treats it as permission; and an adversary that reuses the receipt for a different artifact revision or acts after revocation is the deviation the compressed record cannot consolidate). Described the shape that survives its own
